catalog.label: Small group tutoring (per person, per hour)

extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional tutoring service. Ask about the subject, year level, current school, and specific topics or goals. Ask whether they prefer in-home, online, or at a centre, and their availability. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed after the first session. Do not promise a specific academic result that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: {price_note} Tutoring is priced per hour. Tell us the subject and year level, and we will confirm the rate.
Yes, we offer online sessions by video call. You will need a device with a camera, a microphone and a stable internet connection.
Yes, in-home tutoring is available in [your service area]. A travel fee applies beyond 15 km, as listed on your quote.
We cover maths, English, science, languages, music and coding. Tell us the subject and the topic you need help with.

kb.q: What year levels do you cover?
kb.a: We cover primary, high school and university students. Tell us the year level and the school or course when you enquire.
Yes, we prepare students for exams and tests, including HSC and VCE. Tell us the exam date so we can plan sessions with you.
Our tutors are [qualification level] and hold [background check, e.g. working with children check]. Ask us for details before you book.
Yes, we help with homework and assignments. Tell us what is due and when, so we can focus the session on it.

kb.q: Do you tutor students with special needs?
kb.a: Yes, we have tutors with experience of special needs. Tell us about the student's needs so we can match a tutor.
Sessions are usually 60 minutes, with 30 and 90 minute options available. Tell us which length suits you best.

kb.q: How often should we have sessions?
kb.a: Many students have one or two sessions a week. We suggest a schedule after we understand your goals.
Yes, small group tutoring is available at a lower rate per person. Group sessions are listed in our rates.

kb.q: Do you offer a trial session?
kb.a: {trial_note} Ask us about the trial when you enquire.

kb.q: Do you offer discounts for multiple sessions?
kb.a: {discount_note} Packages of 5 and 10 sessions are available.
Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee. Please let us know as soon as possible if you cannot attend.
Yes, we hold [insurance type] insurance with [insurer]. Certificates are available on request.
Yes, we tutor adults and mature-age students. Tell us your goals and any previous study when you enquire.
Yes, we tutor undergraduate and postgraduate students. University tutoring is priced per hour, as listed in our rates.
Yes, we offer music tutoring for [list of instruments]. Tell us the instrument and level so we can match a tutor.
Yes, we tutor coding and programming for school and adult learners. Tell us the language or project you want to learn.
